utility_guidance.reporting_note: For suspected TNB supply outage, ask whether neighbours or common areas are also affected before advising external reporting.
Check official water disruption updates before treating building-wide water loss as an internal plumbing issue.
Distinguish public sewer backflow from private internal pipe blockage.

access_notes: Building security requires contractor IC and unit confirmation at guard house.
No unattended entry unless duty manager approves emergency access.
Tenant can attend mornings except Fridays.
Ask building management to reserve service lift for bulky appliance work.

tenancy_agreement_clause_index.agent_use: Ask clarifying questions and save the report; do not decide liability.

tenancy_agreement_clause_index.agent_use: Request tenant availability for routine cases and escalate emergency access decisions to the manager.

tenancy_agreement_clause_index.mock_clause_summary: Renewal, early termination, deposit, and notice questions require written manager response.
tenancy_agreement_clause_index.agent_use: Route lease questions to human review.
